metadata.derivation: Derived by SpektraLab from fujifilm_provia_100f (dyes and structure): Fujifilm instax mini / WIDE datasheet (AF3-076E / AF3-077E), ISO 800, 5500 K, measured 24 h after exposure. Instant print approximated as a directly scanned positive: characteristic curves (reflection density read as transmission density, unmixed with the base dyes) and spectral sensitivity digitized from the manufacturer datasheet; print white tint from the datasheet minimum densities; hanatos2025 adaptation data are the base's.
